statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one Google Chrome or Chromium V8 entry with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-04 and 2026-09-18.
resolution: Fetch the CISA KEV JSON at the deadline; TRUE if any entry lists vendorProject Google, a product containing Chrome or Chromium V8, and dateAdded between 2026-09-04 and 2026-09-18.
failure_condition: The KEV JSON fetched at the deadline contains no Google Chrome or Chromium V8 entry with dateAdded between 2026-09-04 and 2026-09-18.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
